meta.title: Account Deletion
meta.subtitle: Tikky - Receipt and Personal Finance Management

content.text: The preferred and fastest way is to do it directly from the app:

items: Step 3: Confirm the request. Your sessions are signed out and the 30-day grace period begins

content.text: If you cannot access the app, you can also request it by email:

items: Write to tikky.oficial@gmail.com from the email address associated with your account
Use the subject: “Account deletion request - Tikky”
Optionally, state the reason (it helps us improve)

content.text: To protect you against accidental or unauthorized deletions, deletion is not immediate:

items: Days 1-30: Your account is deactivated. If you sign in, the app will show you the final deletion date and you will be able to cancel the request and reactivate the account with all your data intact.
From day 30: Final deletion runs automatically and can no longer be undone.

content.title: Your subscription does not cancel itself:
content.text: Deleting the account does NOT cancel an active paid subscription. Cancel it in Google Play → Payments and subscriptions; otherwise, the platform will keep charging it.
When final deletion completes, the following are permanently erased:

items: Account and identity: email address, name, date of birth, profile picture and login credentials
Receipts and documents: all uploaded images and PDFs and the data extracted from them
Financial data: recorded expenses, income, budgets, subscriptions and recurring expenses
Gamification and preferences: progress, achievements and app settings
AI assistant records: the server-side audit log; conversations only ever existed encrypted on your device
Subscription data: your customer profile on the subscription management platform

content.text: Due to legal or security obligations, only what is strictly necessary is retained:

items: Payment platform billing records: Google Play or the payment provider keep the tax records of your purchases in accordance with their own policies and the law
Pseudonymized security logs: anti-fraud signals that cannot directly identify you
Support feedback: if you submitted feedback, it is unlinked from your identity (it becomes anonymous)

content.title: Backups:
content.text: System backups rotate and expire within a maximum of 90 days; after that, your data also disappears from the backups.
If you have questions about the deletion process or need help, write to us:
More information in the Privacy Policy (rights and retention periods).
